verdict.rationale: The Phaser Editor's AI tooling claims it can "rename a bunch of objects" and "reorganise a scene into layers" without switching tools. The MCP server exposes over 40 tools that agents call from plain-language requests, which suggests multi-object edits can be driven by an agent. That rests on a single marketing line, though, with no documented batch or bulk-operation API or tool and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operation tools in the MCP server or editor, details on scope and limits of multi-item edits, independent or hands-on verification.
